shorts.title: The space between breaths
shorts.visual: Slow zoom into cream-colored scene: hands resting on lap, soft morning light through linen curtains. Overlay: subtle floating dust particles. Lofi beat drops at 3s.
shorts.textOverlay:
the space
between breaths
is where
peace lives
shorts.caption:
Between the inhale and the exhale, there is a pause. That pause is everything. 🍃

#mindfulness #lofi #calm #meditation #breathe

shorts.title: Your nervous system needs this
shorts.visual: Split screen: left side — chaotic city timelapse (fast, stressful). Right side — same scene but slowed, golden hour, a person breathing calmly. At 10s, left side fades out. Only the calm remains.
shorts.textOverlay:
your nervous system
wasn't built for
24/7 urgency

slow down
shorts.caption:
Your ancestors didn't have notifications. Give your nervous system a break today. 🌿

#stressrelief #nervoussystem #lofi #mindfulness #selfcare

shorts.title: 4-4-4 Box Breathing in 20 seconds
shorts.visual: Minimal animation: a circle expanding (inhale 4s) → holding (4s) → contracting (exhale 4s) → holding (4s). Cream background. Gold circle. Text counts '1...2...3...4' in each phase.
shorts.textOverlay:
breathe with me
in  • 4
hold • 4
out • 4
hold • 4
shorts.caption:
Navy SEALs use this. So can you. Box breathing — 4 seconds in, 4 hold, 4 out, 4 hold. Instant calm. 🧘

#boxbreathing #breathwork #meditation #lofi #calm
